subject.title: The highest-PnL strategy is mostly carrying a coin flip

capsule.title: The highest-PnL strategy is mostly carrying a coin flip
capsule.summary: A naive market maker ranks first by mean PnL while carrying seven times the inventory dispersion and 3.5 times the PnL spread of the inventory-skew strategy.
capsule.trigger: Rank twelve paired 20,000-step simulations by total PnL without decomposing spread capture from inventory drift.
capsule.observed: Naive quoting earns 20,853 mean PnL with inventory standard deviation 88.1; skew earns 15,448 with inventory standard deviation 12.0.
capsule.invariant: Every profitability claim must report inventory exposure, uncertainty, volume, toxicity, and an exact PnL decomposition beside the total.
capsule.fix: Keep paired seeds and rank strategies on a multi-metric ledger; assert that spread capture plus inventory PnL equals total PnL exactly.

timeline.title: Sort on one number
timeline.detail: Mean PnL places the naive strategy above the inventory-aware alternative.

timeline.title: Hide carried inventory
timeline.detail: A favorable terminal drift enters PnL as if it were repeatable quoting edge.

timeline.title: Decompose every tick
timeline.detail: The ledger separates 16,238 spread capture from 4,615 inventory PnL.

timeline.title: Keep risk beside reward
timeline.detail: The result remains visible, but it can no longer masquerade as a free improvement.

limits: The fill model has no queue position, partial-fill priority, exchange latency, or observable production fair value.
